# surface: help__connect
# argv: sila connect --help
# mode: help
# exit: 0
--- stdout ---
sila connect  -  connect, verify, and remove sila MCP in a second harness

Usage
  sila connect list
  sila connect add <harness>
  sila connect verify <harness>
  sila connect demo
  sila connect remove <harness> [--yes]

Options
  --json                   Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
  --db=<path>              Knowledge store path
